rules.summary: Core data model and error contract guard: Zero-panic Result propagation and immutable OID hashing semantics
Git object model serialization guard: Strict standard loose/pack object header format and SHA-1/SHA-256 dual compatibility

Impact-slice map guard: a pretest slice may narrow the test targets a change triggers but must never widen a recognised path past its declared set, and an unrecognised crate path must fall back to every target
Lockless in-memory git index concurrency guard: Conflict stage resolution, lock-free slot allocation, and deterministic read-tree/write-tree round-trip equivalence
Myers diff, 3-way merge, Interval Tree O(log N + K) overlap query, and FastCDC chunking algorithm boundary and determinism guard
Resource recycling pool bounded governor: PathJail confinement, zero unbounded transient memory allocations, and deterministic lifecycle reclamation
Storage layer crash safety: Append-only WAL journal consistency, loose ODB integrity, and CAS block deduplication
DAG topology traversal and Poset commutation guard: Cycle detection, ancestor generation indexing, and 3-way structural conflict detection
Smart HTTP transport and packet-line streaming framing protocol compliance and timeout guard
Fractal Git domain gate guard: AST complexity constraints (CC <= 15), non-blocking I/O, and platform portability
LayerVFS CAS snapshot materializer bridge: Fixed-time O(1) page cache mapping and atomic tree commit (advisory: no dedicated executable enforcer yet)
Subsystem DAG single-direction dependency guard: Zero circular dependency and strict L1->L2->L3 layer isolation
Zero transient heap allocation guard in hot loops: Prohibit string, vector, and clone allocations in critical paths
Lock-free in-memory index concurrency guard: Prohibit blocking standard Mutex in virtual staging tree (advisory: no dedicated executable enforcer yet)
Documented unsafe block safety proof guard: Prohibit bare undocumented unsafe blocks in Rust crates
Zero unwrap and expect panic guard: Enforce strong-typed Result propagation across production crates
Facade substantial burden and immutable freeze guard: Enforce substantial facade implementation with ELOC budget and deep object freezing (advisory: no dedicated executable enforcer yet)
Pre-review zone gate bridge verification guard: Strict rule catalog closure and sub-10ms AST slice check
Taxis Kernel Code Verifier (TKCV) formal AST invariant guard: Enforce CFG soundness, handle lifecycle symmetry, parameter arity, and zero transient loop allocations
In-Kernel Canary Engine (IKCE) blind mutation kill rate guard: Candidate verification slice must achieve mutation kill rate K >= threshold with round-trip equivalence
In-Kernel Canary Engine (IKCE) anti-tautology guard: Prohibit vacuous or tautological assertions (assert!(true), identical-operand equality) in verification slices
Direct-Bypass test cache reclamation guard: Transient refs/taxis/test-cache entries must be physically reclaimed immediately after gate evaluation without leaking into canonical CAS
Pre-Review Zone quarantine isolation and Bayesian credit circuit-breaker guard: Candidates failing kernel invariants or credit thresholds must be isolated into refs/taxis/quarantine
Cryptographic telemetry audit hash-chain guard: AuditRecord entries must stay <= 350 bytes with strictly monotonic Lamport clocks and verified HMAC-SHA256 signatures
Four-tier hierarchical audit rollup guard: Milestone card compression and periodic rollup must preserve Merkle root integrity and deterministic summary aggregation

Commit header form guard: conventional type(scope) shape, unicode-character length bounds, trailing period, breaking marker, zero-width and hidden control characters, decorative emoji, and colon separator spacing
Commit section topology guard: semantic slot resolution with bilingual aliases, blank-line separation, duplicate rejection, topological ordering, and ASCII bracket and hyphen list markers
Commit body density guard: substantive character floors for production and non-critical types plus per-section floors for rationale, fix, and verification slots
Commit vocabulary guard: temporary and offhand wording rejected with word-boundary anchoring, inline code and URL masking, and the shared whitelist subtracted before the verdict
Commit unresolved marker guard: TODO, FIXME, TBD, XXX and Chinese deferred markers rejected together with unreplaced template angle-bracket placeholders
Commit empty section guard: a declared section carrying only a heading is rejected, and each change-list bullet must carry substantive content
Commit project scope guard: the project slot must exist, every declared name must match the controlled enumeration exactly, and non-standard project nomenclature is rejected
Commit batch codename guard: construction batch identifiers such as phase numbers, sprint numbers, pass numbers and week tokens are rejected as schedule vocabulary
Merge structure exemption guard: a generated merge message is exempted only when the commit object has two or more parents, never on header text alone
Commit declaration anchor guard: the verification slot must cite a symbol or test name that exists in the added lines of the staged diff
Commit policy tier guard: a command-line policy selector may tighten but never relax the tier declared by the versioned policy manifest
Commit rule identifier guard: every rule identifier quoted in a commit message must be registered in the single-source rule catalog
